fields.description: A red-wine festival at Big White. A VIP private tasting runs 6–9 pm in the Kettle Valley Steakhouse ($150), and the Grand Tasting runs 7–9 pm in the Happy Valley Day Lodge ($100; tickets on sale Nov 1).

updates.name: Big White's Twinkling Trail Light Up

fields.description: The season’s first lighting of Big White’s Twinkling Trail, an illuminated walk through the forest from the Adventure Park trailhead in Happy Valley. Meet at 5 pm.
Santa in the Village Centre daily from 11 am, with a free photo, elf crafts and storytime from 3:30 to 4 pm (Dec 18–23). On Christmas Eve it’s photos only, 11 am to 1 pm.
Christmas Eve in the Village Centre from 4:30 pm: booths, a Loose Moose dance party and fireworks at 7 pm. The Glow Stick Parade needs pre-registration, a lift ticket and a helmet (ages 6+).
Meet Santa at 10:30 am in front of the Big Chair, ski Sun Run together, then warm up with hot chocolate at Santa’s Workshop.
A cooking contest for ages 5–13 on the top floor of the Happy Valley Day Lodge, with contestants assembling at 3:15 pm. Tickets go on sale in November.
A village scavenger hunt: pick up a card at the Events Tent in the Village Centre from 9 am, then return it the next afternoon (Jan 17, 2–4 pm).

updates.name: Mountain Glow: Women's Ski Day with Kelsey Serwa

fields.description: A women’s ski day with Olympian Kelsey Serwa: skiing, a wine lunch, spa extras and champagne après, supporting the Kelowna Women’s Shelter. Full details to come from Big White.

Kelowna Actors Studio’s holiday-season production of Disney’s Frozen, Nov 25 to Dec 20: Wednesday to Saturday at 7 pm, with Saturday matinees at 1 pm and Sunday matinees at 2 pm (dark Mondays and Tuesdays). Doors open at 5:30 pm for dinner before evening shows; food is extra. Tourism Kelowna lists tickets at $72–$99, and many shows are close to selling out.
